translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Lesal yuj sc'anchaj scolval Dios d'a oval

content.text: Mamin rey, yab'ocab' Jehová co Diosal a on̈ yin̈til on̈ vin̈aj Jacob a lesalvi. Aocab' tzach colani ayic ayach och d'a ilc'olal.
Yac'ocab'cot scolval d'ayach masanto d'a stemplo d'a Sion.
Snaocab'cot masanil ofrenda ix ac'a'. Schaocab' sc'ool a silab' tza n̈ustz'aoc.
Aocab' ol ac'an elc'och icha a gana yed' masanil tastac nab'il uuj.
Ol el cav yuj tzalajc'olal ayic ol ac'an ganar eb' ajc'ool. Ol quic'chaan̈ co bandera yuj quic'anchaan̈ co Diosal. Aocab' Jehová tz'ac'an masanil tas c'anb'il uuj.
Cojtacxo ticnaic to a Jehová ol colan vin̈ co reyal sic'b'ilel yuuj. Masanto d'a satchaan̈ to an̈ej ay yico', ol tac'voccot d'ay. Yuj spoder Jehová chi' ol yac' ganar nivac oval vin̈ co reyal.
Ay eb' tz'ac'anoch scarruaje yic oval yipoc sc'ool, ay pax juntzan̈xo eb', a noc' schej eb' syac'och yipoc sc'ool. A on̈xo pax tic, a Jehová co Diosal scac'och yipoc co c'ool.
A eb' chi' spax yip yoc eb', stelvi eb', a on̈xo pax tic jun, tec'tec' caji, lin̈ann̈ej on̈ q'uei.
Mamin Jehová, col vin̈ co reyal. Tac'van̈ d'ayon̈ ayic tzach cavtani.
